categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the electronic specialty materials sector, with main business segments including photovoltaic conductive silver paste (accounting for 94.54% of revenue) and semiconductor packaging materials. The company also engages in material sales and other related businesses. The company serves the photovoltaic new energy and semiconductor electronics industries through research, development, production, and sales of high-performance electronic materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in glass systems, organic systems, and silver powder systems for conductive paste formulation. Manufacturing employs quality control procedures including incoming material inspection, process control, finished product testing, and factory testing. The company uses weighted average method for inventory valuation and implements self-production with sales-driven production model. Key technical innovations include advanced metallization processes for N-type TOPCon batteries, low-temperature silver paste for HJT batteries, and semiconductor packaging materials with varying thermal conductivity levels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include leading photovoltaic manufacturers such as Jinkosolar, JinkoSolar, Trina Solar, Tongwei Solar, Aoxu Technology, Jietai Technology, Zhengtai New Energy, and Yidao New Energy. The company also serves semiconductor packaging customers in LED chip packaging, IC chip packaging, and power semiconductor packaging sectors. End markets include photovoltaic power generation systems and semiconductor electronics applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with major facilities in Wuxi, Yixing, Changzhou, Shanghai, Dongying, and Xinyi. International presence includes Hong Kong subsidiary (帝科电子材料香港有限公司) and Singapore subsidiary (established January 2024). Domestic revenue accounts for 95.08% of total revenue, with international revenue at 4.92%, primarily from overseas customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures specialty materials (conductive silver paste) used in photovoltaic cell production and semiconductor packaging, positioning it as a key material supplier between raw material suppliers (silver powder, glass oxides, organic resins) and downstream photovoltaic cell manufacturers and semiconductor packaging companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening N-type TOPCon battery conductive silver paste market leadership through advanced metallization techniques; accelerating HJT battery low-temperature silver paste development and mass production; developing IBC battery metallization solutions; exploring perovskite/silicon tandem battery applications; and expanding semiconductor packaging materials including high thermal conductivity sintered silver and AMB ceramic substrate soldering paste. R&D investment reached 309.76 million yuan in 2023, representing 3.23% of revenue, with 233 R&D personnel.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of conductive silver paste products to photovoltaic cell manufacturers and semiconductor packaging customers, supplemented by indirect sales through distributors. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company also generates revenue from material sales and other related services. Payment terms typically include credit periods with customers paying primarily through bank acceptance bills.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading global supplier of photovoltaic conductive silver paste, ranked in the first tier of the global supply chain according to German TaiyangNews. The company has received recognition including PVBL Excellence Supplier Award, PVBL 2023 Global Photovoltaic Brand Top 100, and various technology excellence awards. Key competitive advantages include advanced technology, product quality, and established relationships with major photovoltaic manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved significant growth in 2023 with revenue of 9.60 billion yuan, representing 154.94% growth compared to 3.77 billion yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders reached 385.64 million yuan in 2023 versus negative 17.24 million yuan in 2022. Total assets grew to 6.78 billion yuan from 3.36 billion yuan. The company demonstrates strong growth trajectory with expanding production capacity and market share.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high efficiency, stability, and reliability in its product strategy, utilizing premium raw materials and advanced quality management systems (ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001 certified). Key differentiation includes customized product capabilities, rapid performance improvement speed, and comprehensive solutions for different battery technologies (P-type, N-type TOPCon, HJT, IBC). The company provides integrated metal electrode solutions with superior optical-electrical conversion efficiency and reliability, supported by responsive technical service mechanisms and collaborative innovation with industry partners.
